action: Golden hour. A clean wide view of the whole forecourt with the canopy lights just coming on against a warm sky. The dealer stands small but upright near the island, looking out towards the road. Everything is orderly and calm. Composed with clear empty sky in the upper third so a name can be laid over it afterwards.
lighting: Rich golden-hour light, warm sky, canopy lights just warming up, long soft shadows. The most beautiful frame in the film.
camera: Wide vertical. Upper third is clean open sky with nothing in it. The canopy sits across the middle. The dealer and the island occupy the lower third. Everything sharp. 35mm.
detail: Deliberately leave the upper third of the frame clean and uncluttered for a title in post. NO signage, NO lettering, NO logos, NO number plates anywhere in the picture.
feeling: The brand card. Calm, established, worth trusting.
motion: Almost nothing moves. The dealer stands still. A very slow push in. Nothing enters or leaves frame, nobody walks, nobody speaks.
